svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.26k stars in total, about 1.08k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 464, aube 2025, fnox 2221, hk 1239, pitchfork 675, usage 1052, +5 more 585.
